description: This is a Java test class for the InitializationFilter component of the OpenMRS web application, containing unit tests for initialization property loading and whitelisting behavior.

classes.name: InitializationFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for InitializationFilter, testing property loading and configuration merging.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture before each test.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans system properties after each test.

methods.name: shouldLoadConnectionUrlFromProperties
methods.description: Verifies that the connectionUrl value is correctly injected and matches expected value.

methods.name: shouldPrioritizeSystemPropertiesOverEnvironmentAndScript
methods.description: Tests that system properties override environment variables and installation script values.

methods.name: initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent_shouldNormalizeEnvironmentVariablesCorrectly
methods.description: Ensures environment variable keys are correctly normalized and loaded.

methods.name: initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent_shouldKeepSpecialEnvironmentKeysWithoutNormalization
methods.description: Checks that specific environment keys remain unaltered.

methods.name: initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent_shouldFallbackToInstallScriptWhenNotInSystemOrEnvironment
methods.description: Tests fallback logic to install script properties when system and environment variables lack specific keys.

methods.name: initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent_shouldReturnNullForNonExistingProperties
methods.description: Verifies that missing properties remain null.

methods.name: initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent_shouldMergePropertiesFromSystemEnvAndInstallScript
methods.description: Validates that properties are merged correctly from system, environment, and install script.

methods.name: initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent_shouldInitializeWizardModelCorrectlyFromProperties
methods.description: Checks that the wizard model is correctly populated from the install script properties.
